met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Hissar, Moradabad, Gorakhpur, Muzaffarpur, Balurghat and thence east-southeastwards to Manipur.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation over central Pakistan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 32°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Bay of Bengal & adjoining South Bangladesh between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Bangladesh & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Trough from North west Bihar to Manipur across upper air cyclonic circulation over East Bangladesh & Tripura at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
